what_this_digest_proves: The mapping existed, in exactly this form, BEFORE any arm executed. It does not reveal the mapping and cannot be satisfied by a different one. Re-deriving from the salt at reveal reproduces this digest, or the reveal is invalid.
what_it_does_not_prove: Nothing about whether the ROLES stay separate during execution. That is a property of who holds what at run time.
